output: html_document
params:
  model: NULL
  data: NULL

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

# Summary

The table reports fixed effects from the native nlme summary. Standard errors,
denominator degrees of freedom, t statistics and two-sided p-values retain the
model summary defaults. Values use six significant digits; p-values below
1e-6 are displayed as <1e-6. Random-effect and residual variance estimates are
not included in this table.

```{r}
coefficients <- summary(params$model)$tTable
shown <- lapply(as.data.frame(coefficients), function(x) {
  trimws(formatC(x, format = "g", digits = 6, decimal.mark = "."))
})
small_p <- !is.na(coefficients[, "p-value"]) & coefficients[, "p-value"] < 1e-6
shown[["p-value"]][small_p] <- "<1e-6"
fixed_effects <- data.frame(Term = rownames(coefficients), shown, check.names = FALSE)
names(fixed_effects) <- c("Term", "Estimate", "Std. Error", "DF", "t statistic", "p value")
knitr::kable(fixed_effects,
  format = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html",
  row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", 5)),
  caption = "Fixed effects", escape = TRUE
)
```
